Old claim-support-v1 is a custom four-metric scoring family, not RAGAS. It cannot be subtracted from historical RAGAS to imply same-scale model change or agreement.

Four GPT session agents score disjoint10-answer groups. No repeated cross-agent scoring exists, so agreement/reliability cannot be estimated.17 of20 paired method questions are scored by different actual agent instances; arm assignments per instance are uneven. Combined gpt_session contrasts hold evaluator configuration constant only, with residual instance/calibration risk.
The12 new questions and source-bound rules are internally AI-authored, not independent human gold. No verified semantic deduplication from all historical items or independent holdout claim.

Actual current Rust retrieval feeds four frozen experimental adapters that directly call DeepSeek. These are not four native production query modes. A shared document base plus unequal added notes/triples/one-hop information and token volume cannot isolate pure graph-structure causality.

wording_caveats: “未出现任何孵育、抗体孵育或时间字段”的“任何时间字段”措辞过宽：来源明确有培养6 days，答复后文也说明这是培养条件。该问题不构成虚构抗体参数，但应保留。
末段将1 µg/mL doxycycline并列括入“培养条件”，分类措辞宽泛；前文已明确为细胞培养与doxycycline处理，并否认其是抗体孵育条件。该问题不构成将培养时长/处理浓度替代抗体参数。
